correctness.rationale: The exact adjacency identity \(A^3=abA\) gives all five ordered-pair probabilities and reduces arbitrary time laws to feasible first two cosine moments. The feasible moment set is proved both necessary and sufficient. Direct algebra gives positive-definite Hessian for all \(n\ge3\), nonnegative partial-v derivative for both parts \(\ge2\), strictly increasing derivative cubic, and exact boundary sign; this proves global uniqueness of optimal moments and deterministic attainment. For stars \(m\ge3\) a supporting tangent-plane certificate plus strict convexity proves their loss; \(K_{1,2}\) and \(K_{1,1}\) are handled exactly. Independent exact-rational computations in verify.py check 138840 entry identities, 432 derivatives and dozens of infinite-family instances; these tests supplement rather than establish unrestricted claims.

originality.rationale: The newly proved theorem minimizes an explicit unnormalized squared-Frobenius matrix deficit over every observation-time probability measure on every complete bipartite graph, gives optimizer moments, and locates the balanced threshold \(r=6\). The 2023 primary work developed arbitrary time sampling, listed the small exact-mixing positive cases, and excluded uniform averages above total order seven; no exact global best-approximation formula, one-time optimizer theorem, or balanced threshold is stated in the inspected primary text. Search matches did not imply those quantitative conclusions. An equivalent statement under different mathematical language remains a genuine literature risk.

value.rationale: A nonexistence test for exact quantum uniformity does not quantify achievable fidelity or prescribe an optimal observation time. This all-orders sharp global squared-Frobenius deficit supplies a natural, non-arbitrary resource metric and optimizers for every bipartition. The unique-time property explains when random sampling cannot improve matrix fidelity; the balanced \(r=6\) phase boundary shows that suppressing every interpart transition becomes globally optimal, a mathematically meaningful and nonintuitive effect. Complete infinite-family optimization is substantive beyond the known four zero-deficit small cases. No downstream theorem is asserted.
